mathematical_findings.annual_target_share: After exact annual restoration, holdings have common post-fee scale Wf times w. End shares equal w_i*(1+r_i)/sum_j w_j*(1+r_j), so scale/CPI cancel and no separate new portfolio simulation is required for these ratios.
mathematical_findings.liquidation_fee: Let A=x_equity+x_bond. With fee charged on new bill purchases, transferred=A/(1+c), fee=c*A/(1+c), available=x_bill+A/(1+c). available+fee=sum(x). This matches core.execute_target(x,e_bill,c), including existing-bill-only and zero-fee boundaries.
mathematical_findings.not_double_fee: Hypothetical liquidation is computed from endpoint shares only, gives ratio+drag=1 and does not alter any investment-path fee or wealth. It does not add actual trading, withdrawal or client liability.
mathematical_findings.drift_vs_floor: The target bill floor is an allocation convention. Returns can push the end share below it despite a valid target; the diagnostic labels that drift and does not redefine suitability/admission.
mathematical_findings.real_bill_loss: A positive nominal bill gross can be a negative real bill return after inflation. The separate negative-real-return indicator avoids treating bills or convertibility as real capital insurance.

identity_and_information_findings.own_fit: Each outer refit uses its saved training identity list and effective assigned product. Training/evaluation intersection is rejected. Each prior own-H job/scenario/profile record must exist exactly once with identical effective label and assigned flag.
identity_and_information_findings.own_horizon: Each profile retains original H: A5/B15/C30/D25/E6. All120 original IDs once per profile yield600 metadata rows, while annualrows=sum_assigned H. C30 is never copied to B15/E6 or a Review entry.
identity_and_information_findings.Review: A missing effective product is financialNULL, never a hypothetical cash strategy. Existing A/D Review entries remain NULL and contribute no annual records. Static C product properties do not authorize any separate Q2 execution service.
identity_and_information_findings.timing: Current returns/inflation are used only to describe year-end shares and real bill returns of an already selected static product; no effective assignment or target is optimized on them.
identity_and_information_findings.development_gate: The driver verifies source-freeze readiness, protocolSHA, allow_final=False, exact1-120 declared IDs and source/input hashes before calling the raw loader with range(1,121),allow_final=False. The loader ignores unrequested final return values before their numeric parse.
identity_and_information_findings.failure_evidence: An attempt is created before parser access. Assignment/other failures leave a failed manifest and traceback; any existing output is refused. Missing sourcefreeze blocks before parser or attempt creation.
